items.text: LA Chargers (MNF day update, Mon Nov 16): OUT - WR Ladd McConkey (back; downgraded Sunday, did not travel), CB Isas Waxter (ankle), S Kendall Williamson (calf). G Branson Taylor (ankle) placed on IR; OL Rashawn Slater on IR. WR Brenen Thompson (hamstring) was doubtful on the final report. Activated from IR: TE David Njoku (fibula) and LB Denzel Perryman (pectoral, season debut); DE Myles Adams elevated. Still questionable: G Kayode Awosika (fibula), DL Justin Eboigbe (ankle); WR Tre' Harris off the report. Justin Herbert starts. Official inactives not yet released (~6:45pm ET).
items.source: NBC Sports/PFT (Chargers activate TE David Njoku, LB Denzel Perryman for Monday night vs. Ravens, Nov 16); Yahoo Sports (Ladd McConkey ruled out for Week 10, Nov 15)

items.text: Baltimore (final report, Sat Nov 14): OUT - S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee, fourth straight game). QUESTIONABLE - RB Adam Randall (neck/hamstring, possible activation). WR Rashod Bateman (calf) and G Vega Ioane (knee/shoulder) practiced and are not designated; Calais Campbell and Ronnie Stanley had rest days. QB Lamar Jackson (dislocated right thumb) out 6-10 weeks; Jacoby Brissett (acquired from ARI) makes his first Ravens start.
items.source: BaltimoreRavens.com (Ravens rule out Jaylinn Hawkins for Monday Night Football, Nov 14); Yahoo Sports MNF preview (Nov 16)
